title: Blades in Phantom Blade Zero - the 26 With a Recorded Location
description: All 26 blades in Phantom Blade Zero, grouped by one-handed, dual-wield and two-handed, with where each one is found and what its property does. Every entry links to its own page.
keyword: phantom blade zero blades, primary weapons phantom blade zero, all weapons list

sections.title: What Blades Are
sections.content:
Blades are the primary weapon class in Phantom Blade Zero. Soul carries two of them at the same time, alongside two Phantom Edges in the secondary slots - a 2 + 2 loadout rather than one weapon plus an off-hand.

This page lists the 26 blades that have a recorded acquisition point, split across three families: one-handed, dual-wield and two-handed. S-GAME put the shipped total at more than 30, so this is not the whole roster - it is the part a source ties to a location, which is the only part you can act on.

The family split is the actual choice, because reach, speed and guard-break trade against each other through the weapon rather than through a stat line.

sections.title: Why Switching Matters More Than Which Blade
sections.content:
Switching weapons refills stamina immediately and lets a combo continue. That single mechanic is why the combat reads closer to Ninja Gaiden than to a FromSoftware fight: the aggressive line is sustainable because the resource comes back on the swap.

Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and on blocking. Because both spend it, blocking everything runs the resource dry at the worst moment.

sections.title: How Blades Are Obtained
sections.content:
Three routes cover almost the whole list. Boss drops are the largest group - the game gives you the weapon of the thing that killed you. World pickups hang off bells and outposts and are the ones people walk past. Tempering converts Sanguine and Sanguine Reach into their upgraded forms, which is why the starting blade is not a throwaway.

The weapon-by-weapon table is on the weapons hub.
